content.json:
# SOC Operations and Agent Performance

The incident queue as a whole. **Overview** answers "are we keeping up": how many incidents, how
fast they are acknowledged and closed, and how they were classified. **Rules** shows which rules
cost the most time for the least result. **Agent** shows what the Autonomous SOC Analyst did, read
from the labels it writes on each incident (`soc-agent`, `soc-agent:<disposition>`,
`soc-agent:class:<alert class>`). **Health** shows whether the tables are still receiving data and
whether any rule is failing.

Times: *acknowledge* is creation to first change of the incident; *close* is creation to closure.
The rule failure table needs Sentinel health monitoring switched on (Settings, Auditing and health
monitoring); without it the table is empty.

**Tables read:** `SecurityIncident`, `SecurityAlert`, `Usage` and, when present, `SentinelHealth`. A tile or chart for a table you do not collect shows an error; the rest still works.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Created = count(),
            Open = countif(Status != "Closed"),
            OpenHigh = countif(Status != "Closed" and Severity == "High"),
            Closed = countif(Status == "Closed"),
            MinutesToAcknowledge = avgif(datetime_diff("minute", FirstModifiedTime, CreatedTime), isnotnull(FirstModifiedTime)),
            MinutesToClose = avgif(datetime_diff("minute", ClosedTime, CreatedTime), Status == "Closed" and isnotnull(ClosedTime)),
            TruePositives = countif(Classification == "TruePositive"),
            NotThreats = countif(Classification in ("FalsePositive", "BenignPositive"))
| project Tiles = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Incidents", "Value", Created),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Open", "Value", Open),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Open, high severity", "Value", OpenHigh),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Closed", "Value", Closed),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Mean minutes to acknowledge", "Value", round(MinutesToAcknowledge, 1)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Mean hours to close", "Value", round(MinutesToClose / 60.0, 1)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "True positive % of closed", "Value", iff(Closed > 0, round(100.0 * TruePositives / Closed, 1), 0.0)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "False or benign positive % of closed", "Value", iff(Closed > 0, round(100.0 * NotThreats / Closed, 1), 0.0)))
| mv-expand Tile = Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tile.Metric), Value = todouble(Tile.Value)
content.title: Incidents in the time range
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Incidents = count() by bin(CreatedTime, {TimeRange:grain}), Severity

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status == "Closed"
| summarize Incidents = count() by Classification = iff(isempty(Classification), "Undetermined", Classification)
content.title: How closed incidents were classified
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Incidents = count(),
            StillOpen = countif(Status != "Closed"),
            MeanMinutesToAcknowledge = round(avgif(datetime_diff("minute", FirstModifiedTime, CreatedTime), isnotnull(FirstModifiedTime)), 1),
            MeanHoursToClose = round(avgif(datetime_diff("minute", ClosedTime, CreatedTime), Status == "Closed" and isnotnull(ClosedTime)) / 60.0, 1)
            by Severity
| extend Position = case(Severity == "High", 1, Severity == "Medium", 2, Severity == "Low", 3, 4)
| order by Position asc
| project Severity, Incidents, StillOpen, MeanMinutesToAcknowledge, MeanHoursToClose
content.title: Response times by severity
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status != "Closed"
| extend Position = case(Severity == "High", 1, Severity == "Medium", 2, Severity == "Low", 3, 4),
         LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| order by Position asc, CreatedTime asc
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status,
          AgeHours = datetime_diff("hour", now(), CreatedTime),
          AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
          Agent = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText),
          IncidentUrl
| take 250
content.title: Open incidents, oldest first within each severity
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Incidents = count(),
            Closed = countif(Status == "Closed"),
            TruePositives = countif(Classification == "TruePositive"),
            NotThreats = countif(Classification in ("FalsePositive", "BenignPositive")),
            MeanHoursToClose = round(avgif(datetime_diff("minute", ClosedTime, CreatedTime), Status == "Closed" and isnotnull(ClosedTime)) / 60.0, 1),
            Provider = take_any(ProviderName)
            by Rule = Title
| extend NotThreatPercent = iff(Closed > 0, round(100.0 * NotThreats / Closed, 1), real(null))
| project Rule, Incidents, Closed, TruePositives, NotThreats, NotThreatPercent, MeanHoursToClose, Provider
| top 50 by Incidents desc
content.title: Incidents by rule: volume against result

SecurityAlert

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo)
| where isnotempty(AssignedTo)
| summarize Closed = countif(Status == "Closed"),
            StillOpen = countif(Status != "Closed"),
            MeanHoursToClose = round(avgif(datetime_diff("minute", ClosedTime, CreatedTime), Status == "Closed" and isnotnull(ClosedTime)) / 60.0, 1)

content.json:
The Autonomous SOC Analyst labels every incident it processes. **page** means it escalated to a
person immediately, **queue** means it left the incident for working hours, **auto_close** means it
closed the incident itself, and **pending** means it is waiting for evidence. An incident with no
`soc-agent` label was never seen by the agent.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| extend Handled = LabelText has "soc-agent",
         Disposition = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText)
| summarize Incidents = count(),
            HandledByAgent = countif(Handled),
            AutoClosed = countif(Disposition == "auto_close"),
            Paged = countif(Disposition == "page"),
            Queued = countif(Disposition == "queue"),
            Pending = countif(Disposition == "pending"),
            MinutesToVerdict = avgif(datetime_diff("second", FirstModifiedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0, Handled and isnotnull(FirstModifiedTime))
| project Tiles = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Incidents the agent processed", "Value", HandledByAgent),
    bag_pack("Metric", "% of all incidents", "Value", iff(Incidents > 0, round(100.0 * HandledByAgent / Incidents, 1), 0.0)),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Closed by the agent", "Value", AutoClosed),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Escalated to a person at once", "Value", Paged),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Left in the queue", "Value", Queued),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Waiting for evidence", "Value", Pending),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Mean minutes from creation to first agent update", "Value", round(MinutesToVerdict, 2)))
| mv-expand Tile = Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tile.Metric), Value = todouble(Tile.Value)
content.title: What the agent did

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| extend AlertClass = extract(@"soc-agent:class:([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)", 1, LabelText),
         Disposition = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText)
| where isnotempty(AlertClass)
| summarize Incidents = count(),
            AutoClosed = countif(Disposition == "auto_close"),
            Paged = countif(Disposition == "page"),
            Queued = countif(Disposition == "queue")
            by AlertClass
| order by Incidents desc
content.title: Alert classes the agent saw

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where tostring(Labels) has "soc-agent:auto_close"
| project ClosedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification, Reason = ClassificationReason,
          Comment = ClassificationComment, IncidentUrl
| order by ClosedTime desc
| take 250
content.title: Incidents the agent closed
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where tostring(Labels) has "soc-agent:auto_close" and Status != "Closed"
| project LastModifiedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, ModifiedBy, AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
          IncidentUrl
| order by LastModifiedTime desc
| take 250
content.title: Closed by the agent and open again: decisions a person reversed
content.noDataMessage: No incident the agent closed has been reopened.

content.query:
Usage
| summarize LastRecord = max(TimeGenerated), MB = round(sum(Quantity), 1), Billable = take_any(IsBillable) by Table = DataType
| extend HoursSinceLastRecord = datetime_diff("hour", now(), LastRecord)
| project Table, LastRecord, HoursSinceLastRecord, MB, Billable
| order by HoursSinceLastRecord desc, MB desc
content.title: When each table last received data
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let Largest = Usage
    | summarize MB = sum(Quantity) by DataType
    | top 8 by MB desc
    | project DataType;
Usage
| where DataType in (Largest)
| summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024.0, 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), DataType
content.title: Ingestion over time, eight largest tables (GB)
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, SentinelResourceName:string, SentinelResourceType:string, Status:string,
               Reason:string, Description:string) []),
    (SentinelHealth)
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Analytics Rule" and Status in~ ("Failure", "Warning")
| summarize Failures = countif(Status =~ "Failure"),
            Warnings = countif(Status =~ "Warning"),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Reason = take_any(Reason),
            Details = take_any(Description)
            by Rule = SentinelResourceName
| order by Failures desc, Warnings desc
content.title: Analytics rules that failed or ran with a warning
content.noDataMessage: No rule failures recorded. If health monitoring is not switched on, nothing is recorded.

content.json: These are the detection rules in this repository for this area (`Detection-rules/` in SentinelWork). A rule with 0 alerts is either not deployed, not enabled, or has had nothing to report in the time range. Alerts are matched to rules by name, so a rule you rename in Sentinel stops being counted here.

content.query:
let Rules = datatable(RuleId:string, AlertName:string, RuleSeverity:string, Tactics:string) [
    "SO-001", "Log source stopped sending data", "Medium", "DefenseEvasion",
    "SO-002", "Analytics rule is failing to run", "Medium", "DefenseEvasion",
    "SO-003", "High severity incident not picked up within 30 minutes", "Medium", "Operational",
    "SO-004", "One rule is creating an excessive number of incidents", "Low", "Operational"
];
let AlertCounts = SecurityAlert
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
    | summarize AlertCount = count(), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName;
Rules
| join kind=leftouter AlertCounts on AlertName
| project RuleId, Rule = AlertName, Severity = RuleSeverity, Tactics, Alerts = coalesce(AlertCount, 0), LastAlert
| order by RuleId asc
content.title: Rule coverage
content.noDataMessage: No rules are defined for this area.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Log source stopped sending data", "Analytics rule is failing to run", "High severity incident not picked up within 30 minutes", "One rule is creating an excessive number of incidents"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
| summarize Alerts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), AlertName
content.title: Alerts over time, by rule
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.
